purpose: Sample nonphysical namespace multiplicity around strong physical/P2 states to test whether metadata abundance is independent of physical evidence and harvest useful security, standards, R&D-statistics and biological-custody sources.

policy.rule: Raw namespace multiplicity is accumulated even for P1/P2 targets but has zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: A target's existing physical classification is not strengthened by CVE, standard, catalog, article, bug, rule or dataset identifiers with the same digits.
policy.no_hit: Post-coverage scans are append-only; absence and later discovery remain separately auditable observations.
